name: Pragma BioSync Smart Base Layer
description:
A seamless, skin-close underlayer in deep slate blue with subtle hexagonal texture — the visible signature of its embedded sensor mesh. Covers torso and upper arms. Pragma's logo is heat-pressed at the left hip in silver-gray, small and tasteful. The fabric has a slightly cool, almost slick hand feel from the conductive polymer threading.

Designed for Tier 3-4 professionals who want passive health monitoring without visible wearables. Integrates with standard BCI health dashboards and M88 corporate wellness platforms. Reads as understated — you'd never know it was smart unless you knew to look.
materials: flat elastic waistband with data-loop thread
functionality: Continuous passive biometric monitoring — heart rate, core temp, cortisol proxy via skin conductance, hydration index. Temperature-regulating fiber actively adjusts breathability. Data syncs wirelessly to BCI or paired device. Low-power draw; charges passively from body heat via thermoelectric strip at waistband.
what_it_says: You invest in your body's performance data — health is an asset you manage.
story_hooks: Pragma's wellness platform sells anonymized biometric aggregates to corponation HR departments — the wearer's stress spikes during certain meetings are already in someone's file.
A specific firmware version has a documented exploit that lets anyone with the right BCI credentials read the wearer's real-time cortisol levels — useful if you're negotiating against them.
A medic running off-grid is using a hacked Pragma layer to monitor a patient who can't afford a hospital visit, piping the data through a cracked wellness account.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, second-skin base layer in deep slate blue that hugs the torso and upper arms with athletic precision. The surface catches light subtly with a hexagonal micro-texture that reads as sophisticated rather than technical at casual glance. Minimalist and purposeful—the uniform of someone who values function without flash.
physical_description.fit: Compression-adjacent but not restrictive; a true second-skin fit that moves with the body. Covers torso fully, extends to mid-upper arm. Seamless construction creates an unbroken silhouette beneath outer layers.
physical_description.primary_material: Conductive polymer-threaded synth-knit blend; soft on skin but with a subtle slickness from embedded sensor mesh. High moisture-wicking treated weave.
physical_description.texture: Smooth to the touch with a barely-visible hexagonal embossed pattern across the entire surface—the sensor grid made tactile. Cool hand feel, almost clinical. No visible seams or stitching.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep slate blue (nearly midnight but warm-toned) as primary. Heat-pressed Pragma logo in muted silver-gray at left hip. No other markings.
distinctive_features: Embedded hexagonal sensor mesh visible as subtle surface texture
Conductive polymer threading for biometric data transmission
Seamless construction with no visible seams
Heat-pressed Pragma Systems logo at left hip
Integrated with standard BCI and M88 corporate wellness platforms
Designed for passive health monitoring without visible wearables
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 professional—mid-grade corporate wellness integration, accessible to working-class tech workers and lower-management corp staff.
physical_description.cultural_context: Corporate wellness compliance; signals someone monitored by employer health systems. Worn by office workers, field technicians, mid-tier employees who accept augmentation as routine. Not flashy, but unmistakably connected.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; with wear, the hexagonal texture becomes slightly more pronounced from repeated compression cycles. No visible degradation—synthetic materials maintain appearance for years.
